title: plectranthus thymiflorus
intro: Plectranthus thymiflorus, commonly known as Thymiflora or Mexican thyme, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus thymiflorus include expectorant and antispasmodic effects, which help to relieve coughs and soothe the digestive system. The plant's bioactive constituents include essential oils and phenolic compounds, such as rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
